title: Design System: Omkar AI — Conversational Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero headlines and the home greeting only. Light weight is the identity; never bold.

body.purpose: Chat answers, descriptions, paragraphs. Reading lines under ~65ch.

label.purpose: Instrument readouts: dates, metrics, tech, roles, eyebrow labels.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Contact card, toast, contextual chat bubble.

shadows.name: hanging
shadows.purpose: Scrollytelling experience cards — deepest shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-luxe
motion.purpose: The signature easing — every entrance and spring feel in the system.

motion.name: state-150
motion.purpose: State transitions: hovers, border shifts, icon fills.

motion.name: spring-panel
motion.purpose: Slide-out panel and mobile bottom sheet.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Grids collapse below this; project gallery switches 2-col → 1-col.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Rail returns / mobile menu hides; content gains 48px left margin.

components.name: Primary Send Button
components.description: The only filled button in the system — a 32px aurora circle that sends the chat message.
components.html: <button class="ds-send" aria-label="Send message"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#080809" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 19V5"/><path d="m5 12 7-7 7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 999px; background: #4f8ef7; border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s, background 0.2s, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-send:hover { background: #5f9bf8; } .ds-send:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(79,142,247,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-send:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The default action button — hairline seam, dimmed steel, quiet cockpit-glass hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-ghost"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="4" width="20" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="m22 7-8.97 5.7a1.94 1.94 0 0 1-2.06 0L2 7"/></svg> Send Email</button>

components.name: Suggested Prompt Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped starter question — frosted glass, lifts and brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-prompt { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #a0a0a8; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-prompt:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #161618; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); color: #f2f2f3; } .ds-prompt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(79,142,247,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tech Pill
components.description: Instrument readout tag — 11px Geist Mono fact chip. Accent-tinted variants inherit item color at ~8% fill.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: #a0a0a8; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; }

components.css: .ds-pcard { background: #0d0d0d; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-pcard:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-pcard:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(79,142,247,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #c084fc; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(192,132,252,0.6); } .ds-pcard h3 { margin: 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #f2f2f3; } .ds-pcard p { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #a0a0a8; } .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

components.name: Chat Composer
components.description: The runway input — frosted glass, hairline seam, aurora border on focus, cursor-tracked radial gradient.
components.css: .ds-composer { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; border-radius: 16px; border: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); padding: 14px 18px; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: rgba(79,142,247,0.4); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 24px; resize: none; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #f2f2f3; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; padding-right: 40px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #505058; } .ds-composer .ds-send { position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; }

components.description: Slide-out panel section header — mono eyebrow readout with a 24px aurora underline.

components.name: Availability Status
components.description: The clearance signal — pulsing green dot with label, the system's 'open to opportunities' beacon.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #3ecf8e; } .ds-status span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3ecf8e; animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(62,207,142,0.4); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px transparent; } }

narrative.overview:
The visitor is a passenger being guided in for landing. The site is the air-traffic control tower of Omkar's career: a near-black night sky (#080809) with a single instrument panel of lights — one aurora-blue beacon for anything live or interactive, gold for wins, green for clearance to reach out. The airplane intro literally brings the visitor in to land; after that, the entire interface behaves like cockpit glass: dark, precise, layered, and lit only where it matters.

The personality is precision luxury, quiet drama. Everything is deliberate: 0.5px hairlines instead of borders, Geist's quiet geometry for display type, monospace labels read like instrument readouts, and motion uses one signature easing curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) so every transition feels sprung, never bouncy. The drama arrives in rare, earned moments — the landing intro, the lightfall background, a gold shimmer on a first-place card — never as constant noise.

The confirmed anti-reference is the neon cyberpunk overglow and gradient soup common to dark 'AI' sites. This system rejects that entire lane: no neon fills, no rainbow gradients, no saturated glow on large surfaces. Glow is reserved for life: a pulsing dot, a hover accent, a live connection.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black layered surfaces (void → tarmac → cockpit glass) separated by 0.5px hairlines, never heavy borders.
One primary light — Aurora Gauge Blue — used only for interactive and live states.
Geist display at light weights with tight tracking; Geist Mono as instrument readouts.
Glass via backdrop blur on panels, rails, and sheets; depth via soft black shadows, not colored glows.
One easing curve everywhere; state transitions at 150ms; entrances at 400–600ms.
Motion reduced for prefers-reduced-motion in every animation path.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Aurora Gauge Blue covers under ~10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes it a beacon; a second full-strength blue surface on the same screen is a defect.

rules.name: The Status Lock Rule
rules.body: Green and gold are status lights, not decoration. Green = open to opportunities / success. Gold = first place. Nothing else may borrow them.

rules.name: The No-Bold-Display Rule
rules.body: Display type is always light or medium weight; bold display is the signature of the templates this system rejects. Weight contrast comes from mono vs sans, not black display type.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: If it's a fact a recruiter scans for (dates, metrics, tech, roles), it's Geist Mono. If it's a sentence, it's Inter.

rules.name: The Glow-Means-Live Rule
rules.body: A glow on the page is always a status signal — pulsing availability, an active node, a hover state. Decorative glow that isn't a signal is rejected (see: no neon soup).

rules.name: The Black Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are pure black on alpha. A colored shadow is a different design system; don't introduce one.

dos: Do build surfaces in the void → tarmac → cockpit-glass family with 0.5px hairlines; seams, not borders.
Do keep the home conversation inside the 760px centered column.
Do set every fact a recruiter scans for (dates, metrics, tech, roles) in Geist Mono.
Do reserve Aurora Gauge Blue for interactive and live states — small doses only.
Do use the signature easing cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) and 150ms state transitions; 400–600ms for entrances.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion — the system already carries reduced-motion rules for every animation.
Do let gold mean first place and green mean 'available'.
donts: Don't use neon fills, rainbow gradients, or saturated glow on large surfaces — the neon-soup look is the system's anti-reference.
Don't set display type in bold or heavier than medium; light-weight Geist is the identity.
Don't use pure #ffffff; Instrument White is #f2f2f3.
Don't bring the serif editorial faces (Libre Baskerville, cream, ink) outside the landing sequence — the night console speaks sans and mono.
Don't give shadows color; black-on-alpha shadows only.
Don't use green or gold for decoration — they are status lights.
Don't widen the chat column, move the rail, or drop the 48px content margin on desktop; the runway geometry is fixed.
